description: This file contains extension methods for the Orleans testing framework, specifically for retrieving configuration and test cluster options from host builders and configurations.

classes.name: TestClusterExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for retrieving configuration and test cluster options in Orleans testing environment.

methods.name: GetConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the IConfiguration object from an IHostBuilder's properties.

methods.name: GetConfigurationValue
methods.description: Retrieves a specific configuration value by key from an IHostBuilder.

methods.name: GetTestClusterOptions
methods.description: Retrieves the TestClusterOptions object from an IHostBuilder.

methods.name: GetTestClusterOptions
methods.description: Retrieves the TestClusterOptions object from an IConfiguration.
